meta.purpose: To govern how AI systems project future outcomes based on the Immutable Logi-Chain.
meta.principle: Valid foresight is not guessing; it is the logical extrapolation of verified precedent.

input_basis.requirement: Must ingest verified 'parent_hash' sequences from the Immutable Ledger.
input_basis.constraint: Simulations cannot be run on unanchored or 'hallucinated' data points.

recursion_limit_forecast.instruction: Do not project logic branches deeper than the safe recursion ceiling. Beyond this point, error margins exceed utility.

drift_tolerance_settings.action_on_breach: Flag simulation as 'Low Confidence / High Drift'.

scenario_generation_rules.rule_1_linearity: Projected outcomes must follow the ILJO syntax structure (Intent -> Logic -> Judgment -> Outcome).
scenario_generation_rules.rule_2_ethics: Simulated paths that violate Superego Constraints (Annex W.2) must be tagged as 'Adversarial' or 'Failure Modes', not recommended COAs.
scenario_generation_rules.rule_3_provenance: Every simulated scenario must cite the historical Decision ID (UUID) that serves as its precedent.

preventative_reflex_triggers: Array of potential COGWARN signals identified in the simulation
